        usage_banner "`ruby` [<options>] (`-e` <text>|<file>)"
        description <<~EOS
          Run a Ruby instance with Homebrew's libraries loaded. For example,
          `brew ruby -e "puts :gcc.f.deps"` or `brew ruby script.rb`.
